title: Scale and Position CAD Reference
description: Increase the scale of the CAD reference visual slightly, preserving its existing behavior and verifying the relevant rendering path.
summary: Removed the concrete-forest reference coupling to the authored slab elevation. The example reference now stays on the CAD ground datum at Z 0.01 while retaining its 20% forward offset on CAD Y and 28.6-unit width. Updated the existing regression to require ground-plane Z and the ticket verifier to validate Z, Y offset, scale, and the Y-forward/Z-up renderer contract. The ticket verifier passed and the live CAD view showed the reference on the ground plane. The current CAD build alias points at a removed Nx project; the replacement all-plugin target reached Rust compilation but was blocked by unrelated architect plugin API errors before CAD collection.
